qualifier: via B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
name: B cell receptor signaling, activation and differentiation
rationale: Members are BCR signaling events (BTK, RAS, second messengers, CD22 tuning) and B cell proliferation/differentiation, distinguishing them from T cell receptor/costimulation themes and from B cell subset marker or germinal centre/plasma cell themes.

qualifier: Rho effector (ROCK, PAK) and ILK complex cytoskeletal remodelling
name: Integrin-dependent cell spreading and Rho-effector cytoskeletal remodelling
rationale: All members concern integrin/substrate adhesion driving cell spreading and migration via ILK-PINCH-parvin and Rho-ROCK/PAK remodelling, unlike confusables centred on fibronectin matrix, stress fibres, platelet activation or Rap1/MAPK integrin activation.

qualifier: germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Meiosis, germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover meiotic recombination/segregation, gametogenesis, piRNA/KRAB/HUSH retroelement silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition, whereas confusables focus on sperm motility/fertilization, gonadal hormones or a narrower spermatid set.

qualifier: mannosyl donor (GDP-mannose, dolichyl-phosphate mannose) synthesis
name: Mannosyl donor synthesis and its congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: All members are GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose production (PMM2, MPI, PGM1, DPM1-3, DOLK, SRD5A3) or their CDGs, unlike confusables covering ALG oligosaccharide assembly, Golgi glycosyltransferase CDGs or dolichol synthesis.

qualifier: nuclear vRNP replication and host antagonism
name: Influenza virus nuclear RNP replication and host antagonism
rationale: Members are influenza steps (vRNP import, vRNA/mRNA synthesis, NEP/NS2 export, translation) plus NS1 inhibition of PKR and host mRNA processing, distinguishing from SARS-CoV and RSV replication themes.

qualifier: processing, modification and aminoacylation, plus RNA pseudouridylation and editing
name: tRNA maturation, aminoacylation and RNA base modification
rationale: Members span nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation with pseudouridylation and ADAR editing, unlike confusables centred on rRNA modification/mitoribosome assembly or wybutosine/t6A fidelity modifications.

qualifier: ISG effectors restricting the viral life cycle
name: Interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors restricting viral life cycle
rationale: Members are type I/II interferon response signatures, ISG15 and host restriction of viral replication, release and transport, whereas confusables emphasise RIG-I/TLR/IRF3 sensing and interferon induction, type III/chemokine output, or IFN-gamma Th1/MHC II.

qualifier: incretin and nutrient GPCR signaling
name: Incretin and nutrient GPCR control of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1/GIP, glucagon-family, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, muscarinic and somatostatin receptor control of insulin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, unlike confusables on PKA/adrenergic insulin inhibition, K-ATP channels or calcitonin/amylin receptors.

qualifier: apical-basal polarity with adherens junction adhesion
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and adherens junction maintenance
rationale: All members concern establishing/maintaining epithelial apical-basal and cytoskeletal polarity, apical constriction and adherens-junction adhesion, unlike generic junction, desmosome, junction assembly or podocyte themes.

qualifier: with inhibitory receptor (CD22, SIRP) restraint of B cells and phagocytes
name: Fc-gamma receptor and inhibitory-receptor control of immune activation
rationale: Members are Fc-gamma receptor activation/inhibitory signaling, CD22 and SIRP inhibitory interactions and negative regulation of BCR, phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, unlike confusables centred on ADCC/hypersensitivity, phagocytic cup formation or myeloid signatures.

qualifier: synthesis, branching and lysosomal degradation defects
name: Glycogen synthesis and degradation and their storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown, glycophagy and GSD 0, II, IV, XV and Lafora (plus GCK MODY), distinguishing from glucose-6-phosphatase GSD I and glycolysis themes.

qualifier: calcium influx and ATP release
name: Mechanosensitive channel-mediated calcium influx and ATP release
rationale: Members concern membrane channel responses to pressure/load (PIEZO1, hemichannel ATP export, K-ATP SUR2, gap junctions, calcium entry, volume, membrane repair), unlike confusables on endothelial shear stress, glutamate receptor signaling or connexin trafficking.

qualifier: PAPS synthesis/transport and nucleotide-sugar transport in skeletal dysplasias
name: Activated sulfate and nucleotide-sugar donor supply in chondrodysplasias
rationale: Members are PAPS synthesis/transport, UDP-glucuronate formation, nucleotide-sugar and sulfate transport and their chondrodysplasias, unlike confusables on GAG chain biosynthesis, selenium metabolism or SLC35 CDGs.

core: Ureteric bud and nephric duct development
qualifier: from intermediate mesoderm induction
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation from intermediate mesoderm
rationale: Members trace intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, distinguishing from confusables on ureteric bud elongation, renal vesicles or metanephric mesenchyme proliferation.

qualifier: intrinsic and extrinsic caspase activation through execution, with necroptosis
name: Intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis through execution, with necroptosis
rationale: Members span BCL-2/BH3 mitochondrial permeabilization, death receptor/caspase-8 signaling, apoptosome, execution (DNA fragmentation, lamina breakdown) and necroptosis, whereas confusables are narrower (p53 transcriptional, T cell AICD, or extrinsic-only).

qualifier: driving cytokine production
name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing driving cytokine production
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition and the resulting IL-12, IL-23, IL-10, GM-CSF and IFN-gamma production, unlike confusables that are downstream cytokine receptor signaling (IL-17, IL-23, IL-10, IL-27).

qualifier: progenitor proliferation in kidney development and lymphopoiesis
name: Progenitor proliferation control in developing kidney and lymphopoiesis
rationale: Members regulate cell proliferation and number in metanephric kidney development and in bone marrow/thymic lymphopoiesis, combining both contexts unlike kidney-only or haematopoietic-only confusables.

core: Plasma membrane response to mechanical stress
qualifier: pressure, blebbing, repair and volume
name: Plasma membrane blebbing, repair and volume under mechanical stress
rationale: All members concern plasma membrane responses to mechanical load and pressure (PIEZO1 in osteocytes, blebbing, repair, volume decrease), unlike confusables on phospholipid scrambling/flippases and apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: otic vesicle-derived structures and vestibulocochlear nerve
name: Inner ear morphogenesis from the otic vesicle
rationale: Members are otic vesicle formation and morphogenesis of cochlea, semicircular canals and the vestibulocochlear nerve, unlike confusables on hair cell function/fate, craniofacial, pharyngeal gland or eye development.

core: Adipose thermogenesis and lipolysis product handling
qualifier: glycerol and fatty acid transport and receptor sensing
name: Adipose thermogenesis with glycerol and fatty-acid transport and sensing
rationale: Members cover cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, fatty acid cycling and transport, aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport and free fatty acid/hydroxycarboxylic acid receptors, unlike confusables on brown/beige or white adipocyte differentiation or water-only aquaporins.

core: Neuroendocrine control of feeding and growth
qualifier: leptin, growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes
name: Neuroendocrine control of feeding, growth and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members are leptin/ghrelin appetite regulation, GH/prolactin receptor signaling and growth, and ACTH-cortisol secretion/response, distinguishing from neuropeptide behaviour, gut hormone GPCR or stress-only HPA confusables.

qualifier: RNA pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members are mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing, pseudouridine synthesis and mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on cytosolic tRNA processing/aminoacylation, mitochondrial translation or broad mitochondrial gene expression.

qualifier: inherited transport disorders (LPI, HHH syndrome)
name: Cationic amino acid transport and its inherited disorders
rationale: All members are arginine, lysine and ornithine transport or their transporter disorders (SLC7A7, SLC25A15), unlike confusables on urea cycle enzymes, organic anion or neutral amino acid transport.

core: Placental and early embryonic lineage development
qualifier: trophoblast differentiation with stem and germline maintenance
name: Trophoblast, placenta and early embryonic lineage development
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm/trophoblast differentiation, labyrinth and decidualization plus inner cell mass, primordial germ cell and stem cell maintenance, unlike mammary, germ cell maturation or ocular vascular confusables.

qualifier: inositol phosphate and compartment-specific PIP synthesis
name: Phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate interconversion across membranes
rationale: All members are synthesis/turnover of PIPs at specific membranes and of soluble inositol phosphates, unlike confusables on PI transfer at ER contact sites and ER/Golgi membrane organization.
